setup_punt_not_linux: This installer is for Linux hosts — Windows: {url}
setup_preflight_sudo: Run this as your normal user, not under sudo — it calls sudo itself where needed, and the host runs as you (host.env, the services)
setup_preflight_curl: curl is required (install it with your package manager first)
setup_punt_no_os_release: No /etc/os-release — can't tell which distro this is: {url}
setup_password_prompt_no_ip: The web console (https://this device:47992) asks for a password.
setup_punt_nixos: NixOS: add the flake input and enable the module instead — {url}
setup_floor_debian: Debian {version} is below the glibc floor — {floor}, or build from source: {url}
setup_floor_ubuntu: Ubuntu {version} installs the package but can't host — its desktop is too old to create a virtual display ({url}). Runs on {floor}.
setup_floor_mint: Linux Mint {version} (Ubuntu 24.04 base) installs the package but can't host — {url}. LMDE 7 and Mint 23 can.
setup_floor_fedora: No RPM group for Fedora {version} yet — {url}
setup_cert_no_certutil_generic: certutil is not installed, so the console keeps its browser warning — install nss tools and re-run
setup_phase_options: Options (each one can be changed later)
setup_phase_linger: Starting at boot with nobody logged in
setup_phase_start: Starting the host and the web console
setup_phase_installed_no_repo: Host, web console and plugin runner are already installed ({version}) — skipping the install, continuing with setup
setup_channel_no_repo: --channel {channel} had nothing to act on: no Punktfunk package repo is configured here, so this install did not come from one (built from source?). Channels: {url}
setup_phase_installed_update: Host, web console and plugin runner are already installed ({version}, {channel} channel) — updating to the current build
setup_omarchy_later: Run it later with: punktfunk-omarchy setup   ({url})
setup_omarchy_missing: punktfunk-omarchy is not on PATH — the host package should ship it; see {url}
setup_conflict_active: Another streaming host is active on this device — both want TCP 47990 (its web UI, Punktfunk's management API)
setup_conflict_port_moved: Clients learn the port from discovery; the console and plugins read it from mgmt-endpoint. Details: {url}
setup_conflict_stop_first: Stop it before you start Punktfunk (e.g. sudo systemctl disable --now sunshine) — {url}
setup_groups_no_input: No 'input' group on this system — virtual gamepads need /dev/uinput access; see {url}
setup_gamestream_conflict: With another GameStream host running, only one can bind the Moonlight ports — stop the other first or skip this
setup_headless_gamescope: No desktop session is installed here, so the host will spawn a headless gamescope per connect
setup_firewall_none: No active firewall found — nothing to open ({url} if you add one later)
setup_start_no_console: No punktfunk-web.service on this device — the console is not installed, so nothing will answer on 47992 ({url})
setup_steamos_no_uninstall: The on-device build has no uninstall script — the build container, the files under your home and the root-owned tuning come off by hand: {url}
setup_steamos_build_slow: The build runs on this device — it asks for your sudo password first, then takes about 20 minutes on a first run (about a minute on a re-run) and prints nothing until it finishes
setup_step_failed: That step failed — fix it and re-run (the script is safe to repeat), or follow the page by hand: {url}
setup_cert_no_certutil: certutil is not installed, so the console keeps its browser warning — {command} and re-run
setup_cert_host_not_running: The host is not running, so there is no certificate to trust yet — re-run once it is
setup_cert_not_written: The host has not written its certificate yet ({path}) — re-run to trust it
setup_cert_trusted: Console certificate trusted — a Chromium that is already running picks it up on restart
setup_cert_refused: certutil refused the certificate — the browser warning stays; click through once instead
setup_password_write_failed: Couldn't write {path} — {error}; the console will generate one instead
setup_apt_channel_empty: The {channel} apt channel offers no Punktfunk packages — check /etc/apt/sources.list.d/punktfunk.list ({url})
setup_pacman_not_on_channel: {pkg} is not on the {channel} channel — removing it (the {channel} packages carry its files)
setup_pacman_not_on_target: {pkg} is not on the target channel — removing it (the target packages carry its files)
setup_linger_no_systemd: No systemd as PID 1 here (a container?) — skipping linger, nothing would honor it
setup_start_no_user_session: No user systemd session here (ssh without a login session?) — run this from a terminal in your desktop session:
setup_banner_docs: The per-distro pages stay the documented path; this automates them. Docs: {url}
setup_summary_group: Full controller (joins the punktfunk group — grants usbip attach)
setup_summary_linger: Start at boot with nobody logged in
setup_uninstall_outro: Removed. Left on purpose: ~/.config/punktfunk (identity, pairings, host.env, plugins — a reinstall picks them up), the punktfunk, punktfunk-door and punktfunk-update groups, and any firewall rules you opened.
setup_uninstall_cleanups: The one-command cleanups for each are on {url}
setup_verify_not_active: punktfunk-host is not active — journalctl --user -u punktfunk-host -e ({url})
setup_verify_not_listening: Nothing on UDP 9777 yet — give it a second, then: journalctl --user -u punktfunk-host -e
setup_nvidia_no_driver: NVIDIA GPU without the NVIDIA driver — nothing can encode until it's installed: step 1 of {url}
setup_nvidia_no_module: NVIDIA GPU, but nvidia-smi can't talk to the driver — the kernel module didn't load (Secure Boot? run: mokutil --sb-state): {url}
setup_outro_done: Done. Next: let a device in.
setup_outro_client: Open Punktfunk here and pick the PC you stream from — then approve this device in that host's console.
setup_outro_host: On the device you play on, open Punktfunk and pick this host. Approve it in the notification here, or in the console.
setup_outro_console_loopback: Console: {url}  (this device only — PUNKTFUNK_UI_BIND in host.env opens it up)
setup_outro_console: Console: {url}  (its certificate is this host's own)
setup_outro_password_read: Password — this prints it, until you first sign in: {command}
setup_outro_no_console: The web console is NOT on this device, and pairing and every setting live there.
setup_outro_relogin: Group changes apply after a restart of this device (controllers won't work until then).
setup_why_couch_box_headless: Game Mode / HTPC box hosts are usually headless
setup_why_linger_steamos: the SteamOS installer always enables it
setup_why_group_steamos: the SteamOS installer always joins it
setup_why_group_couch_box: Game Mode / HTPC box — virtual Steam Deck pad
setup_components_both: The host, plus the client app
setup_why_group_default: joins the punktfunk group (grants usbip attach)
setup_why_group_off: the pad arrives as a plain Xbox 360 controller
setup_why_gamestream_off: Punktfunk's own apps don't need it
setup_why_linger_off: the host waits for your session
setup_row_components_hint: Host: the PC you stream from. Client: the device you play on. One PC can be both.
setup_row_channel_hint: canary is the latest main build; stable is the released one.
setup_row_group_hint: Joins the punktfunk group for paddles, trackpads and gyro. It grants usbip attach, so only on a machine you trust.
setup_gamestream_hint: Serve Moonlight, Artemis, or another third-party client. Punktfunk's own apps don't need this.
setup_row_clipboard_hint: Share the clipboard between this host and your clients. Each client still opts in per host.
setup_row_linger_hint: Starts the host at boot so it is reachable before anyone logs in. It can only stream once a session exists.
setup_row_start_hint: Enable and start the services once the install finishes. Off installs the files and starts nothing.
setup_row_omarchy_toasts_hint: A toast when a device asks to pair, and when a stream starts or stops.
setup_row_omarchy_idle_hint: Holds off the idle lock for as long as a stream is running.
setup_row_omarchy_theme_hint: The console follows whatever theme Omarchy is on, instead of its own palette.
setup_uninstall_item: Uninstall — remove the packages and the repo
setup_password_prompt: The web console ({url}) asks for a password.
setup_password_prompt_generated: One is generated for you unless you set your own. Print it any time with:
setup_bind_prompt: Where should the web console be reachable?
setup_bind_prompt_body: It is how you pair devices and change every setting.
setup_bind_option_address: A specific address (e.g. a VPN interface)
setup_bind_address_prompt: Type the address the console should listen on. It has to be an address this device already has.
setup_password_type_prompt: Type the console password. It is stored on this device only, and shown here as you type.
setup_win_existing_default_dir: Existing install: {version} at the default dir
setup_win_existing_unknown: Existing install: unknown version at the default dir
setup_win_outro_console_loopback: Open the web console:  https://127.0.0.1:47992  (the certificate is the host's own — continue past the warning)
setup_win_outro_console_loopback_body: It answers on this device only. Set PUNKTFUNK_UI_BIND in host.env to reach it from another device.
setup_win_outro_console: Open the web console:  https://<this-PC>:47992  (the certificate is the host's own — continue past the warning)
setup_win_outro_password: Password: punktfunk-host web password  (from an elevated PowerShell)
setup_win_outro_install_client: Install a client on the device you stream to ({url}), connect, and click Approve in the console.
setup_win_outro_open_client: Open Punktfunk from the Start menu and pick your host.
setup_win_note_coexist: Running next to Sunshine/Apollo: Punktfunk's management API is on :{port} — {url}
setup_win_note_public: This network is Public and the firewall rules don't apply there — the host is unreachable until that changes ({url})
setup_win_refuse_build: The Punktfunk host needs {floor} — this device reports build {build}, where the virtual display can't start. Nothing was installed.
setup_win_phase_stop: Stopping the running host for the upgrade
setup_win_arp_kept: The Add/Remove Programs entry keeps its key — winget and the updater keep tracking this install
setup_win_driver_not_updated: The virtual-display driver is NOT being updated with this host — the two must match, or every session ends with 'driver outdated'
setup_win_phase_drivers: Drivers (a hiccup warns and never aborts)
setup_win_network_made_private: Network '{network}' becomes Private — the standard firewall rules apply there
setup_win_network_open_public: Keeping the network Public and opening the firewall for it (--allow-public-network=on)

match.n=one: Network '{names}' is set to Public, and the firewall rules below don't apply there — the host will be unreachable until the network is Private or the public rules are added ({url})
match.n=other: Network '{names}' is set to Public, and the firewall rules below don't apply there — the host will be unreachable until the network is Private or the public rules are added ({url})

setup_win_mgmt_already_moved: Management port already moved in host.env — leaving the operator's value alone
setup_conflict_active_named: {service} is active on this device — both want TCP 47990 (its web UI, Punktfunk's management API)
setup_win_mgmt_bind_note: PUNKTFUNK_MGMT_BIND=0.0.0.0:{port} — the service step writes it to host.env and opens the firewall for it
setup_win_moonlight_stays_off: Moonlight compatibility stays off — the other host owns those ports while it runs
setup_win_kept_on_purpose: Kept on purpose: %ProgramData%\\punktfunk (identity, passwords, update cache) and any VB-CABLE install
setup_win_network_change_failed: Couldn't change '{network}' — set it to Private in Windows Settings, or re-run and open the public firewall

match.n=one: Payload unpacked into {dir}; {count} in-use file ({names}) is replaced at the next restart
match.n=other: Payload unpacked into {dir}; {count} in-use files ({names}) are replaced at the next restart

match.n=one: {count} in-use file under {dir} ({names}) goes with the next restart
match.n=other: {count} in-use files under {dir} ({names}) go with the next restart

match.n=one: {count} in-use file under {dir} ({names}) goes with the next restart - or remove the folder by hand
match.n=other: {count} in-use files under {dir} ({names}) go with the next restart - or remove the folder by hand

setup_win_app_runtime_failed: Couldn't install the Windows App Runtime — install it manually: {url}
wizard_row_driver_hint: The virtual display the host streams from.
wizard_row_gamepad_hint: Controllers arrive on the host as real gamepads.
wizard_row_hdr_hint: HDR for Vulkan and DXVK titles.
wizard_row_public_fw_hint: Open the firewall on networks marked Public. Off, the host is reachable on private networks only.
wizard_row_start_service_hint: Start streaming as soon as the install finishes.
wizard_row_tray_hint: The status icon next to the clock, for every user.
wizard_row_web_bind_hint: Where the console answers: your local network (never the internet), this device only, or one address such as a VPN interface. It is how you pair devices and change every setting.
wizard_row_password_hint: Generated for you — keep it or type your own. It signs you into the web console and is shown again on the finish page.
wizard_row_desktop_icon_hint: A Punktfunk shortcut on the desktop.
wizard_row_gamestream_hint_busy: Serve Moonlight, Artemis, or another third-party client. {service} owns the Moonlight ports while it runs — this plane can't bind until it stops.
wizard_row_gamestream_hint_busy_unnamed: Serve Moonlight, Artemis, or another third-party client. Another streaming host owns the Moonlight ports while it runs — this plane can't bind until it stops.
wizard_coexist_note: {service} detected — Punktfunk's management API moves to :{port}. {service} keeps :{old_port}.
wizard_coexist_note_unnamed: Another streaming host detected — Punktfunk's management API moves to :{port}. That host keeps :{old_port}.
wizard_welcome_uninstall: This removes Punktfunk from this device. Identity, pairings and passwords stay — a reinstall picks them up.
wizard_welcome_manage: Reconfigure keeps what is on this device and applies your changes. Uninstall removes it — identity, pairings and passwords stay.
wizard_welcome_host: This device becomes the one you stream from: the Punktfunk host sends its screen, audio and games to the devices you play on.
wizard_welcome_client: This PC becomes a device you play on: the Punktfunk client shows the stream from the PC you stream from.
wizard_recommended_host: The defaults: virtual display and gamepad drivers, the HDR layer, a tray icon, and the service starts right away. A web console password is generated for you.
wizard_custom_host: Pick the drivers, Moonlight compatibility, firewall scope, autostart and the console password yourself.
wizard_recommended_client: Install into your profile with Start-menu shortcuts.
wizard_custom_client: Choose whether a desktop shortcut is added.
wizard_coexist_title: Runs next to your other streaming host
wizard_network_body: Windows scopes the standard firewall rules to private networks, so on this network the host would be silently unreachable. VPN and virtual adapters are routinely Public by design — this changes only the named network, never a global setting.
wizard_network_make_private: This is my home network — make '{name}' Private (recommended)
wizard_network_make_private_unnamed: This is my home network — make 'this network' Private (recommended)
wizard_network_open_public: Keep it Public, open the firewall for it
wizard_install_failed: Something went wrong — the log below has the step.
wizard_done_removed: Punktfunk was removed from this device.
wizard_done_kept: Kept on purpose: %ProgramData%\\punktfunk (identity, passwords, update cache) — a reinstall picks it up.
wizard_done_host_installed: The Punktfunk host is installed and streaming.
wizard_done_host_updated: The Punktfunk host is up to date.
wizard_done_client_updated: The Punktfunk client is up to date.
wizard_password_stored: Stored in %ProgramData%\\punktfunk\\web-password. To change it later, edit that file and run `punktfunk-host service restart` from an elevated PowerShell.
wizard_next_console_body: Approve devices, pick what to stream, change settings. The certificate is the host's own — continue past the browser's warning.
wizard_next_client_body: On the device you play on — Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, Steam Deck — then connect and press Approve in the console.
wizard_next_open_body: It is in the Start menu. Pick your host from the list, or add one by address.
wizard_next_no_host_body: Install the Punktfunk host on the PC you stream from.
tray_toast_streaming: A client is streaming from this host
